assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production seamless material texture for the panels and buttons of a cyberpunk city roleplaying game UI. A square, edge-to-edge close-up of black smoked glass over dark brushed steel: a sheet of near-black tinted glass with very fine horizontal brushed-metal grain faintly visible beneath it, a few hairline micro-scratches, and a scatter of very small fine rain droplets and mist beads on the surface. Straight-on orthographic surface, no perspective, no objects, no border or frame, no panel joints, no rivets, no screws. Rich hand-painted game-art material, tactile and crafted rather than a photograph. Color and contrast restrained enough to sit beneath readable light UI text: cold blue-black, almost neutral, with only the faintest hint of violet in the darkest areas; no bright highlights, no reflections of signs, no colored light, no glow, no large streaks. Seamless repeating tile in both axes, evenly lit, no vignette, no directional lighting gradient, no letters, no glyphs, no symbols, no circuitry traces, no logos, no scenery, no watermark. Output 1024 square.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One production cyberpunk game interface fitting, square image, front-facing orthographic, no perspective. ONE heavy square electrical junction box seen exactly from the front, centred, filling about 70 percent of the image. The box is thick dark brushed steel with a chamfered raised rim, four large hex bolts (one at each corner), scuffs, rain beads and small welded seams. Its face is a square plate of black glass set into the steel, and mounted on the glass is an abstract neon sign made of real bent glass tubes: one hot MAGENTA tube ring (a perfect circle) and inside it one electric CYAN tube bent into a perfect square with rounded corners, both brightly lit with a white-hot core, with tiny steel tube clips and short black cable tails. The tube light spills softly onto the glass and the steel rim INSIDE the box only. The right face and the bottom face of the box each carry a wide, recessed, dark cable-entry slot with a thick rubber gland, the two slots identical. The whole object is exactly symmetric across the diagonal from its top-left corner to its bottom-right corner, so it looks the same when mirrored left to right or flipped upside down: no element has an up or a down. Rich hand-painted realistic game UI art, sculpted volume, hard specular edges on the steel, heavy and industrial, readable when shrunk to a 48 pixel icon: big simple shapes, thick tubes. BACKGROUND: everything that is not the box must be perfectly flat, uniform pure green #00FF00 with no shadow, no gradient, no texture and no glow spilling onto it, so it can be keyed out to transparency. Do not use green anywhere in the object. No arms, no pipes leaving the box, no letters, no numbers, no glyphs, no logos, no warning symbols, no arrows, no lightning bolt, no screen, no buttons, no switches, no dials, no scenery, no frame around the image, no watermark. A practical small detailed asset, not an illustration of a room.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production wide 3:1 landscape banner artwork for a cyberpunk roleplaying game's campaign lobby. Hand-painted premium environment art with deep atmospheric perspective. A narrow city street after dark in heavy rain, seen from street level looking down its length. On the right two thirds: tall black glass towers and stacked brushed-steel balconies, fire escapes and cable bundles closing in overhead, crowded with glowing neon tube signs in hot magenta and electric cyan. Every sign is an ABSTRACT SHAPE only: bare bent glass tubes forming rings, concentric circles, plain triangles, chevrons, zigzags, parallel bars, arcs and simple outlines of rectangles, mounted on steel brackets and junction boxes with visible conduit runs. Wet asphalt mirrors the magenta and cyan light in long streaked reflections; steam rises from a grate; rain falls in fine lines; a few distant window lights in dull amber far down the street. On the left third a calm stretch: a dark wet wall of black glass and steel shutters with one single long horizontal cyan tube and soft reflections, nothing else. Strong contrast between deep blue-black shadow and saturated tube light, glow haloes in the rain mist. Reads well as a very wide shallow header: the largest shapes on the right, a calm dark left third, the interesting content in the middle horizontal band. Painterly realism, moody, dense, alive. Absolutely NO lettering of any kind: no words, no letters, no numbers, no kanji, no kana, no hangul, no pseudo-writing, no glyphs, no logos, no brand marks, no billboards with pictures, no holograms of figures. No people, no vehicles, no characters, no UI widgets, no picture frame, no watermark. Entire canvas opaque edge-to-edge scenery.

Reads well as a very wide shallow header: the largest shapes on the right, a calm pale left third, the interesting content in the middle horizontal band. Painterly realism, damp, tired, still alive. Absolutely NO lettering of any kind: no words, no letters, no numbers, no kanji, no kana, no hangul, no pseudo-writing, no graffiti, no glyphs, no logos, no brand marks, no posters. history: Generated 2026-11-22 for the first Neon District build, one image per prompt, each kept from its first generation. The night set is the catalog's art. Every sign in the artwork is a bare abstract tube shape (rings, bars, chevrons, triangles, arcs); each file was inspected at full size for lettering, glyphs and logos and none was found. The corner piece is a single junction box with no arms, so it has no up: its two cable slots face the two rails and swap places across the diagonal. Day direction, chosen by Albert on 2026-11-22: the same street on a wet overcast day with the signs left on. It replaced two earlier day candidates, the corporate tower and the sunny street with the signs off; the tower was set aside as another district's theme. The day frame and corner are edits of the night pieces so the geometry is identical.
